description: You're volunteering at an archaeological survey. The archaeologist left early and emailed messy field notes. Complete the artifact catalog spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/archaeology_survey/artifact_catalog.xlsx using the notes from field_notes.txt. The first 5 entries are examples showing correct format. Catalog all 14 artifacts (exclude modern glass contamination). Follow the format: Catalog ID as CA-YOL-42-[GRID]-[NUM], standardized categories (Ceramic/Lithic/Faunal/Shell/Charcoal), complete all fields. Save with Ctrl+S.
